logo_files.description: Current official Paolo's lockup: dark-green blackletter 'Paolo's' over green script 'Restaurant & Bar', transparent background. Retrieved from Wayback archive of mypaolospizza.com (site currently offline).

Full-lockup white knockout of the current mark, ESRGAN-2x upscaled from the 456px source then knocked out at high res. This is the asset rendered on the card. Counters preserved (30 holes), stroke gate ok (median 5px), interior gate 0 low-contrast on the green primary.

rationale.identity: Single confirmed current identity: the green 'Paolo's Restaurant & Bar' wordmark lockup. Matches the June-2026 Instagram avatar, the 2026 Google image preview, and the Wayback-archived site logo. No mark substitution or identity conflict.
rationale.logo_treatment: Monochrome brand (one dark-green family, no qualifying second color). Per the composition rule, the strong green chroma IS the card primary; a green mark on a green card fails the interior gate (0.797 low-contrast), so a FULL white knockout of the entire lockup is the sanctioned treatment for this flat vector-style mark. Counters were already transparent holes in the source (23 holes), so counter-punch was unnecessary; knockout preserved them (30 holes after 2x upscale).
rationale.descriptor_kept: The 'Restaurant & Bar' script band is hairline (0.8px at render, per-band stroke fail) and free-standing, which normally triggers a strip. It was KEPT because: (1) it is a short designed descriptor that is part of the composed lockup and is literally the business name (DESIGNED-DESCRIPTOR exception, Riwaaz lesson), and (2) empirically, mask-based remove-components left an un-removable sub-128-alpha antialiasing halo that rendered as a messy green ghost, whereas knocking out the whole lockup renders the descriptor as clean legible white script. The full-lockup knockout is both truer to the brand and visually cleaner.
rationale.resolution: Best first-party source is 456px (< 500px). No higher-res first-party vector exists (site offline; Google's larger results are recompressions of this same 456px asset). ESRGAN-2x upscale of the color source to 912px, then knockout at high res, clears the ~680px render box.
rationale.colors: Primary #00472a = vibrant pole of the single green family (top-decile saturation median, not a cluster mean). Secondary #000000 = colors.mjs derive of the primary (the brand green is already near-maximally dark, so the same-hue darker derivative collapses to black); it is well distinguished (deltaE 27.1) where a lighter dark-green (#00301c) failed distinguishability (deltaE 7.4). Text #ffffff wins the deterministic contrast test (10.85 white vs 1.94 black on the green). text-secondary #ffffff gives 21:1 on the black number circle so the digit stays visible.

flags: website_unreachable: official site mypaolospizza.com is offline (ports 80/443 refuse); logo sourced from Wayback archive (2024-11 capture) and current identity confirmed via June-2026 Instagram avatar + 2026 Google results
low_res_source: best first-party asset is 456px (< 500px); shipped mark is a 2x ESRGAN upscale (912px)
hairline_descriptor_kept: 'Restaurant & Bar' script fails the per-band stroke test but was kept as part of the composed lockup (renders cleanly in the full white knockout)
production.notes: Reviewer should: (1) confirm #00472a matches Paolo's true brand green if/when the site comes back online (no live CSS token was available); (2) eyeball the soft white emboss glow around the wordmark on the card (it comes from the source's antialiased edges becoming low-alpha white in the knockout — it reads as an intentional emboss but is a cosmetic artifact); (3) confirm the large black (#000000) secondary footer band + number circle reads as intended against the green — black is the sanctioned derived anchor here, not a lighter green; (4) verify 'Restaurant & Bar' legibility at physical tapcard size. No production systems were written; this is a proposal only.
